messages:
Ethan: quick concept drop 11 — proposing inline threshold "pills" for the SLO alert config screen so users can edit common thresholds (e.g., 99.9, 99.95) without opening the full modal. mock: https://figma.redwood/slo-threshold-pills
Lina: I like inline for speed. couple UX Qs: how do we handle fractional precision (3 vs 4 9s)? do pills open an input popover or turn into an inline editable field?
Ethan: idea: pill click -> small popover with quick numeric input + tertiary "advanced" link that opens full panel. Enter commits, Esc cancels. show validation inline (red outline + text)
Omar: from frontend: popover should be aria-modal=false and use role="dialog" with aria-label for screen readers. prefer controlled input so we can debounce and show server validation. sample PATCH shape: `PATCH /v1/alerts/:id/thresholds { "thresholds": [{"id":"t1","value":0.9995}] }`
Lina: copy nit: label the pills with human-friendly shorthand, e.g., "99.95% (p1)" and tooltip with exact decimal. tooltip: "SLO target: 99.95% — 43 day burn rate"
Zoe: PM NOTE: acceptance criteria: 1) inline edits must not create a new alert revision unless user clicks Save on main form, 2) validation errors should block commit and surface to the popover, 3) keyboard-first flow for power users.
a11y-bot: accessibility reminders: ensure focus is trapped to the popover when open, restore focus to the pill on close, announce changes with a polite live-region like "Threshold updated to 99.95%". color contrast for error states must meet AA.
Omar: implementation detail: we'll keep edits local in component state; commit on popover Confirm -> apply to draft model. telemetry event: `slo.threshold.inline_edit` with {alert_id, old_value, new_value, user_id, method:"popover"}. debounce typing to reduce noise.
Lina: microinteraction: animate pill -> input transform, 120ms fade+scale. when validation fails, shake + tooltip error. propose a small confirmation toast: "Threshold updated — unsaved changes" with an action "Save changes" that links to top-level form.
Ethan: question about presets: should we allow pinning pills as presets (user or org-level)? I can see org admins wanting canonical presets.
Zoe: yes support org presets later. for v1: keep presets local to a project. add a "Save as preset" secondary action in the advanced panel.
Lina: accessibility detail: pills must be reachable by arrow keys when focused (left/right), Enter to edit, and Space toggles selection in multi-select scenarios. add aria-describedby linking to validation text when present.
Omar: backend note: we need optimistic UI for instant feel but revert on server error. have an endpoint `POST /v1/projects/:id/presets` for presets later. also add feature flag slo_inline_pills.v1 so we can roll out gradually.
Ethan: small copy tweaks: change "Edit" CTA in popover to "Quick edit" and confirmation to "Apply to draft" to reduce confusion with persistent save.
Zoe: I'll add ACs to the ticket ALERT-5072 and include rollout checklist (flag, telemetry, e2e tests). tagging @Omar for PR plan.
Lina: I'll push updated frames with high-contrast states and keyboard flow document to figma and paste links here when ready.
